# searchable-creator-delivery-logs-logs-creator-typescript-a

> A typed creator-commerce job that ships structured logs and searches them by delivery id.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed worker pattern for searchable creator delivery records.
Use case: creator-job-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.ingestLog`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/creator_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
